# package pnio

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/pnio"
```

Package pnio encodes and decodes the PROFINET IO application layer (IEC 61158-6-10): the blocks of the connect, control, release, read and write services, the NDR argument headers they travel in over RPC, the PNIO status, identification and maintenance records, diagnosis data, alarm notifications and identification data.

Every block is a typed structure with an Append method and a decode function. Blocks are always big endian; the NDR header around them uses the RPC packet's data representation.

```go
const LT = 0x8892
```

LT is the Ethernet type carried in IOCR and AlarmCR blocks.

```go
const LTIP = 0x0800
```

LTIP is the LT of the IOCRs of RT\_CLASS\_UDP and of an AlarmCR of RTA\_CLASS\_UDP: the EtherType of IPv4 instead of LT. p-net requires it for RT\_CLASS\_UDP and profinet-py builds it for alarms over UDP (observed in implementations, docs/research/EVIDENCE-AR-SR-MCR-UDP.md, D).

```go
const NDRHeaderLen = 20
```

NDRHeaderLen is the length of the NDR argument header of PNIO calls.

```go
const RecordHeaderLen = 64
```

RecordHeaderLen is the length of a read or write header block.

```go
const UDPRTPort = 0x8892
```

UDPRTPort is the UDP port of RT frames of RT\_CLASS\_UDP (34962, 0x8892): Wireshark dissects the payload of UDP port 0x8892 as PROFINET RT. The controller and the device of this module put it in the CMInitiatorUDPRTPort and CMResponderUDPRTPort fields although they use no UDP transport; p-net answers the same responder port.

## Variables

```go
var (
	// DeviceInterface is served by IO-Devices: Connect, Release, Read,
	// Write, Control, ReadImplicit.
	DeviceInterface = rpc.MustParseUUID("dea00001-6c97-11d1-8271-00a02442df7d")
	// ControllerInterface is served by IO-Controllers: the device's
	// Control (ApplicationReady) call.
	ControllerInterface = rpc.MustParseUUID("dea00002-6c97-11d1-8271-00a02442df7d")
	// SupervisorInterface is served by IO-Supervisors.
	SupervisorInterface = rpc.MustParseUUID("dea00003-6c97-11d1-8271-00a02442df7d")
	// ParameterServerInterface is served by parameter servers.
	ParameterServerInterface = rpc.MustParseUUID("dea00004-6c97-11d1-8271-00a02442df7d")
	// EPMInterface is the DCE endpoint mapper (version 3).
	EPMInterface = rpc.MustParseUUID("e1af8308-5d1f-11c9-91a4-08002b14a0fa")
	// NDRTransferSyntax is the NDR transfer syntax UUID (version 2).
	NDRTransferSyntax = rpc.MustParseUUID("8a885d04-1ceb-11c9-9fe8-08002b104860")
)
```

RPC interfaces of PROFINET IO (interface version 1).

### func AppendPDRealData

```go
func AppendPDRealData(b []byte, api uint32, ports []PDPortDataReal) []byte
```

AppendPDRealData appends the PDRealData record (index 0xF841) of the ports: one MultipleBlockHeader per port submodule, holding its PDPortDataReal.

### func AppendPDRealDataRecord

```go
func AppendPDRealDataRecord(b []byte, api uint32, rd *PDRealData) []byte
```

AppendPDRealDataRecord appends the PDRealData record: the interface's PDInterfaceDataReal, then each port's PDPortDataReal, each in a MultipleBlockHeader.

### func AppendWriteMultiple

```go
func AppendWriteMultiple(b []byte, items []WriteMultipleItem) []byte
```

AppendWriteMultiple appends the record data of a WriteMultiple: each write header and its data, padded to a multiple of four octets except the last.

### type PDPortDataReal

```go
type PDPortDataReal struct {
	Slot      uint16       `json:"slot"`
	Subslot   uint16       `json:"subslot"`
	OwnPortID string       `json:"ownPortId"`
	Peers     []PDPortPeer `json:"peers"`
	// MAUType is the IEEE 802.3 MAU type of the link (0: unknown;
	// 0x0010: 100BASE-TX full duplex).
	MAUType           uint16 `json:"mauType"`
	DomainBoundary    uint32 `json:"domainBoundary"`
	MulticastBoundary uint32 `json:"multicastBoundary"`
	// LinkState carries the link state (low octet: 1 up, 2 down) and the
	// port state (high octet).
	LinkState uint16 `json:"linkState"`
	// MediaType is 0 unknown, 1 copper, 2 fiber, 3 radio.
	MediaType uint32 `json:"mediaType"`
}
```

PDPortDataReal is the real data of a port (index 0x802A of the port submodule, and part of PDRealData 0xF841): its own port ID, its neighbors and its link.

#### func DecodePDPortDataReal

```go
func DecodePDPortDataReal(blk RawBlock) (PDPortDataReal, error)
```

```go
func DecodePDRealData(b []byte) ([]PDPortDataReal, error)
```

DecodePDRealData decodes the PDRealData record (index 0xF841) and returns the PDPortDataReal blocks it holds, at the top level or in MultipleBlockHeaders; the other blocks (PDInterfaceDataReal, ...) are skipped.


### type RTClass

```go
type RTClass uint8
```

RTClass is the real-time class in IOCRProperties bits 0-3.

```go
const (
	RTClass1      RTClass = 1
	RTClass2      RTClass = 2
	RTClass3      RTClass = 3
	RTClassUDP    RTClass = 4
	RTClassStream RTClass = 5
)
```

RT classes. RTClass1 is the legacy encoding of unsynchronized RT; in advanced startup mode devices expect RTClass2 for the same traffic.

#### func (RTClass) String

```go
func (c RTClass) String() string
```

String names the RT class. Wireshark calls value 1 the legacy encoding of RT\_CLASS\_1 and value 2 RT\_CLASS\_1 (or RT\_CLASS\_STREAM-RT).

### type StatusError

```go
type StatusError struct {
	// Op names the operation, for example "read 0xAFF0".
	Op     string
	Status Status
}
```

StatusError reports a PNIOStatus other than OK, returned by a peer or produced by a decoder. It matches profinet.ErrRejected and, by class, ErrNotFound (invalid index, slot or API), ErrUnsupported (feature not supported), ErrInvalidState (state conflicts), ErrResourceExhausted (out of AR resources, busy) and ErrAborted (RTA aborts).

#### func (StatusError) Error

```go

```

```go
func (e *StatusError) Is(target error) bool
```

Is implements the matching described on the type.
